description: This file provides placeholder functions for initializing and tracking analytics events within a JavaScript project, intended to be further implemented with specific analytics providers such as PostHog in later steps.

methods.name: initAnalytics()
methods.description: Initializes the analytics provider if environment allows. Currently a placeholder that is safe to call even without environment variables.

methods.name: track(event, properties = {})
methods.description: Sends a tracking event with optional properties. Currently a no-op placeholder.
